Our cost-effective metal carports are worth the investment over traditional wooden barns that are prone to weathering and infestations. Steel agricultural and farm buildings are low-maintenance, yet they provide greater protection from pests, decay, and the elements without the fire hazard of wood.

name: Animal Shelters
description:
Animal Shelters

Millennium’s metal barns can be designed to provide a safe, comfortable space for animals at an affordable cost. Metal barns are more cost effective and easily maintained compared to wood products that are susceptible to rot, mold and insects, making metal the ideal material for long-lasting and durable animal shelters.

With simple updates, your metal barn can remain open for access or fully enclosed for shelter from wind, weather, and other elements. Lean-tos can be added to one or both sides for additional, semi-enclosed space that will shelter animals while giving them the freedom to move and explore outside. For larger animals, a barn can be designed with two enclosed side lean-tos and an open central structure to use as a run-in area. If used as a shelter for smaller animals, open lean-tos can help keep them dry and warm in winter months but cool and shaded in the heat of the summer.

name: Boats
description:
Boats

Storing your boat at a marina is not only expensive but also leaves it easily exposed and open to potential damage. Instead, Millennium’s metal boat covers will protect your boat from all weather, theft, and animal threats all while keeping it close and easily accessible for maintenance.

Our broad range of economical boat covers are made with the highest quality, “Made in the USA” materials and can be customized to fit just about any space and budget. They range from 12′ to 60′ wide and up to 20′ tall and can be constructed up to the length needed.

faqData.question: Durability
faqData.answer:
Our galvanized steel framing is the highest quality offered on the market, and it comes with a 20-year limited Rust-Through Warranty. The warranty can be used for the following:

  • Regular style up to 31’ long
  • Boxed Eave style up to 31’ long
  • Vertical roof style up to any length
  • 12 gauge framing
  • Limited lifetime warranty on all certified units for snow loads and wind
  • Upgrades are also available from 14-gauge to 12-gauge framing for areas that receive great amounts of wind, rain, or snow.

faqData.question: Economic
faqData.answer: Metal buildings are cost-effective and can save you more money in the long run over any kind of wooden structure.

faqData.question: Low-Maintenance
faqData.answer: With low-maintenance metal, these units can be cleaned easily with mild soap and water. Also, unlike structures built from wood components, our steel boat covers will remain free from rust, rot, mold, termites, and insects.

props.title: Carport Options
props.content:
Metal Boat Cover Customization

There are many ways to upgrade or customize your boat cover to fit your needs and budget. It is important to consider space as well as local regulations and weather conditions.

While our certified carports can withstand wind speeds up to 180 miles per hour, if you live in a location that is prone to high winds during hurricanes or tornadoes, you should also consider adding anchors to your carport to help keep it grounded during these events. In these cases, more is better.

Other customization options include:

  • Length, width, and height variations
  • Roof styles, including: regular, boxed eave, and vertical
  • Vertical, horizontal, and lap siding
  • 2 tone wall options
  • Certified, up to 180 MPH wind loads and 65 PSF snow loads
  • 29-gauge or 26-gauge sheet metal
  • 14-gauge or 12-gauge galvanized tubing
  • 16 different available color choices

Millennium’s metal garages are manufactured using American-made parts and the highest quality steel available on the market. These steel-frame structures are reliable options in harsh weather like rain and snow, and they won’t leak or be susceptible to fires like standard wooden structures.

name: RVS
description:
RVs

If you are an RV owner, your rig is often your second home. You put a lot of care into maintaining it, and the same level of care should be put into protecting it.

Metal RV carport covers from Millennium Buildings are manufactured in America and made with the highest quality steel available on the market. Our RV covers are economical and low maintenance, leaving you with more time and money for the journey rather than the upkeep.

We provide a 10 year Rust through warranty for 14-gauge and a 20-year Rust through warranty for 12-gauge on our galvanized steel framing. The metal covers can be cleaned quickly with just mild soap and water and will remain free from rust, rot, mold, termites, and insects.

cards.title: Regular Roof
cards.description: Our regular roof style is affordable, economical, and durable. This style roof has rounded corners and horizontal sheet metal. Regular roof styles are available from 12′ wide to 30′ wide and up to 36′ long and 20′ tall.

cards.title: Boxed-Eave Roof
cards.description: The boxed eave style roof is affordable yet stylish. These units have an A-frame roofline with a horizontal sheet. They are available from 12′ wide to 30′ wide, up to 20′ tall, and up to 36′ long.

cards.title: Vertical Roof
cards.description: Vertical roof styles come in an A-frame roofline and vertical sheet metal. They provide maximum protection and are the highest quality of RV covers available. They are available at any length, from 12′ wide to 60′ wide and up to 20′ tall.

name: Warehouse
description:
Warehouse

Millennium’s metal buildings are ideal for warehouse space. With free-spanning, open interiors and high leg heights, you’ll have ample room to store large volumes and equipment ranging from man-lifts to cranes.

Metal warehouses are versatile solutions for commercial businesses, farming, residential storage, or even additional recreational and community space.

Built with solid steel framing, a welded truss system, and a welded ladder-style leg system, our warehouses deliver maximum durability. We offer structures at any vertical length, up to 20′ tall and 60′ wide. These frameworks are engineered to withstand wind loads up to 170 MPH and snow loads up to 65 PSF, ensuring reliability in harsh conditions.

Our sales specialists and design consultants are available to answer any questions you might have while planning your warehouse. Call today to discuss your options: 1-866-216-8499.

We offer affordable prices, fast and free delivery, financing options, and even a no credit check rent-to-own option. Learn more about our financing options.

name: Workshops
description:
Workshops

Millennium’s metal garages make the perfect foundation for workshops, offering secure, fully enclosed space to protect valuable tools, equipment, and projects from harsh weather, theft, and pests. Built with premium American steel, these units are both durable and cost-effective.

Each workshop can be customized to fit your needs—whether for woodworking, automotive work, hobbies, or crafting. Options include side panels, roll-up garage doors, windows, lean-tos, and more, allowing you to create a functional and efficient space.

Our workshops come standard with a 1-Year Workmanship Warranty from the date of installation, with additional Limited 10–25 Year Warranties available depending on your location. Certified upgrades using 26-gauge sheet metal and 12-gauge galvanized tubing can ensure your building withstands up to 180 MPH winds and 65 PSF snow loads.

From hobbyists to professionals, Millennium’s workshops provide the reliable space you need to get the job done right.
